blocks.text: «The preposition „перед“ + Instr. denotes time prior to (immediately before) a certain event: Я позвоню вам перед обедом.» «„до обеда“ — anytime before dinner; „перед обедом“ — just before dinner.»

DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 77. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.q: Перед ___ (ужин) все, молодые и старые, сели играть в "судьбу".
exercises.why: «The preposition „перед“ + Instr. denotes time prior to (immediately before) a certain event: Я позвоню вам перед обедом.» «„до обеда“ — anytime before dinner; „перед обедом“ — just before dinner.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 77.
